description: STATE screen: US names whose RSI(14) sits in a tail right now (<=35 or >=65), with the 50/150-day levels around it. Answers "what is oversold or extended?". For the session a line was crossed, use get_breakout_moves. Analyst plan.

band.description: Which tail(s) to return. 'both' (default) = every tail row, RSI ascending; 'oversold' = RSI <= 35, ascending; 'overbought' = RSI >= 65, most stretched first.

include_history.description: Include each row's ~40-point 6-month [unix_seconds, close, sma50] series. Default false.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars. Default 1e10 ($10B, the dashboard default); the universe floor is 2e9 ($2B) and smaller values clamp to it.

top.description: Most rows to return after the band/floor filters, in the served order. Default 50; the cut is recorded in `truncated`.

name: get_rsi_watch
